title: IVG Savr 3000 Red Fusion Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Red Fusion IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods blend ripe Strawberry, juicy Cherry and tangy Red Raspberry into a vibrant berry medley. The combination is sweet, bold and slightly tart — a flavour that holds up well across repeat use. Each pod pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 4ml refill container. Once assembled, the refill auto-feeds the pod, giving up to 3000 puffs per kit with no coil swaps or mess. Designed for the IVG Savr 3000 device, this pod uses mesh coil technology for consistent flavour and satisfying MTL vapour. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
